description: Calculate the short perpetual futures position size needed to hedge a spot holding. Use when user asks "how much should I short to hedge my BTC?" or "what margin do I need for a 100% hedge?". Returns: hedgeNotional, requiredMargin, estimatedFundingCost.

fundingRatePct.description: Current 8h funding rate as percentage, e.g. 0.01. Used for cost estimate.

hedgeRatio.description: Percentage of spot to hedge, e.g. 100 for full hedge, 50 for half. Default 100.

leverage.description: Leverage on the perp short. Default 1.

name: primitive.hedge_ratio
